Original source snapshot: d32154faf83b3b785b448d63aaf6accfd7416aac
Based in turn on Mandelbulb3D, originally developed by Jesse, with community contributions:
https://github.com/thargor6/mb3d
License: LGPL 2.1; license texts and original notices are retained.

This is modified source, not an unmodified upstream distribution.
Modification notice dated 2026-11-09, by Glenn Olander and contributors to Mandelbulb3D SE.
Changes include native macOS integration, formula translations and support,
color/map and fog compatibility, emissive lighting with cached repainting,
GPU cancellation and reliability, bounded reflection memory, and formula
execution safeguards. Additional changes include diffuse-opacity-controlled emission,
indirect emissive fill, improved emission sampling and CPU scheduling, and
matching interpolation and color handling. Formula definitions retain their respective author credits.

Corresponding source: https://github.com/Rodrigo-Spacecraft/Mandelbulb3D-SE/tree/rel3
